sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: The pilot replaced **1,200 meters** in two districts. Leak alerts reduced average repair time from 9 days to 2 days (see [[tab:kpi]]). Details of the rollout are in [[sec:rollout]].

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.body:
1. Extend to District 3
2. Integrate billing
3. Review vendor SLA
